table.title: Table to extract
table.description: Select a SAS table to extract

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Type of load: full load or incremental load

primary_key.title: Primary Key
primary_key.description: Column(s) to use as primary key in Keboola Storage

incremental_column.title: Incremental Column
incremental_column.description: Column name for incremental extraction (timestamp or numeric). Only extracts rows greater than last run value.

duckdb_max_memory_mb.title: DuckDB Maximum Memory (MB)
duckdb_max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory allocation for DuckDB processing

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of rows to process at once (lower = less memory, slower)

null_values.title: Null Values
null_values.description: List of strings to treat as NULL values (e.g., 'NA', 'N/A', '.')
